{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Admiral Capo assures me that they are fully trained and alert, and eager to serve alongside their gallant allies, the Yuuzhan Vong.|[[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] to [[Maal Lah]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Ylesia">''[[The New Jedi Order: Ylesia]]''</ref>}}
The '''Peace Brigade Fleet''' was led by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Capo (admiral)|Capo]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

It engaged the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] ships led by Admiral [[Traest Kre'fey]] during a surprise [[Battle of Ylesia (28 ABY)|raid]] at [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]]. Showing their true colors as traitors and cowards, the battle was a short one with many [[Peace Brigade]]rs opting to escape or surrender rather than continue fighting.
